caption:
Feel like you've come too far to be saved? He sings over you before you fall. (Amos 5:2 devotional)

God sings the lament early — not to end you, but so you'll turn while there's still time. The song of grief is really a call: come back.

📌 Save this for your quiet time
💬 What have I quietly decided is too far gone in my life?
